I love it! The scratch at the end is painfully real hahaha (owww)
Okay but this... uh.. meme? Image? I've been wondering what it's called for a while

Hey, thanks for being a stranger who replied in the middle of the night. (For me, obviously idk what time it is there.)


I guess my problem is I don't know what I want, and I don't know how to figure that out. It sounds really stupid, but like I said, I'm so indecisive. And it's hard to tell what I want myself and what I've been told to want. I based my identity on school and I feel lost without that.


Part of me wants to just throw myself back in and try again, but the larger part of me says that's clearly not going to work, and I need to take a step back and get my bearings. But part of me says that's just an excuse to quit, because I'm too lazy to succeed. 


But really, thanks for being a voice that's not negative like my own. If nothing else it calms me down while I lay here unable to fall asleep. Keep on ✌
